pairs.why: Both are the same smooth, softly lit black top hat with a satin red band, and I could not see a difference that brings either one closer to the real cards.
They are near-duplicates: the shape, the soft matte-satin finish and the light all match, and neither is noticeably glossier or more textured.
A's highlights are slightly softer and its brim a little fuller, closer to the gentle sheen of the graduation cap, while B's crown edge is a touch shinier.
The two hats are almost the same in shape, color and finish, so neither is clearly closer.
A's shading is a little softer and less glossy, nearer the real cards' satin finish, while B's top rim highlight is slightly crisper.
The two drawings are effectively the same: same build, same soft light, same smooth finish.
A's brim curls more readily and its light is softer, close to the real cards, while B's highlights are slightly glossier.
I could not see a meaningful difference in rendering or build; both match the real cards about equally.
